# FGN

> FGN is a Sydney-based commercial fit-out contractor delivering office, retail, hospitality and wellness fit-outs, base building make-good, joinery and high-end finishes across NSW, ACT, QLD and VIC.

## Company
- Full human/AI reference page: https://fgn-projects.netlify.app/ai-info/
- About: https://fgn-projects.netlify.app/#about: lean, trade-led team pairing hands-on trade expertise with commercial project controls. Stakeholders deal directly with the team running the job, no layers of management.
- Founded / led by: Elliot Terry-Fagan (Managing Director) and Will Desborough (Construction Manager). Two principals, direct accountability.
- Combined industry experience of the principals: 17 years. Major projects delivered under FGN: 40+. Coverage: NSW, ACT, QLD, VIC.

## Services
- https://fgn-projects.netlify.app/#services
- Commercial fit-outs (office, retail, hospitality, wellness)
- Base building make-good and tenancy reinstatement
- Joinery and high-end finishes
- Scheduling and procurement
- Site management and subcontractor coordination
- QS and contract administration

## Projects
- https://fgn-projects.netlify.app/#projects
- Includes projects delivered directly under FGN (IMAGEN Menstyle barber shop, Mayvun Arc office fit-out) and selected career-history projects delivered by the two principals in prior roles at other Sydney contractors before founding FGN (e.g. The Ribbon: W Hotel & IMAX, 320 Pitt Street, Level 34 & 35 and Levels 16 & 23.04 at 1 O'Connell Street, Level 29 at Chifley Tower, The Malaya, Warren & Mahoney head office). These two categories are clearly labelled on-site and should not be conflated when describing FGN's own company track record.
- Client references: Cilla Arnold (Mayvun Arc), Guy Binder (SGB Group), Erwin Mahdavi (IMAGEN Menstyle). Quotes on the site; contact details available on request, not published.
